title: CrispDeck
shortDescription: Mastodon, Bluesky and Threads: read, crosspost and organize your feeds.
fullDescription:
Bring Mastodon, Bluesky and Threads into one workspace.

READ YOUR WAY
Follow multiple accounts in Feed or organize timelines, mentions, searches, hashtags, lists and RSS in a multi-column Deck. Save layouts as workspaces and choose the home screen that fits your day.

COMPOSE FOR EACH NETWORK
Write a post once, preview each destination, and adjust text for individual networks. Add images, alt text and supported advanced options. Long Bluesky posts can be split into threads.

RECOVER YOUR WORK
Media drafts retain their attached files and editing options. Publishing records progress for each account and thread part so you can reconnect and retry unfinished destinations. Uncertain provider responses require review before retrying.

SCHEDULE ON THIS DEVICE
Schedule posts, move between screens and resume after offline periods. CrispDeck must remain open to publish scheduled posts; a closed app does not post in the background.

YOUR ACCOUNTS, YOUR DEVICE
Connect existing social-network accounts. CrispDeck stores credentials on your device and encrypts them. It has no CrispDeck account signup, advertising or analytics.

CrispDeck is open source under AGPL-3.0. Features and provider support can vary between networks. Support and source: https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispDeck
releaseNotes: Recover media drafts, preview destination text, resume unfinished crossposts and threads, and schedule posts while keeping CrispDeck open. Improved Feed/Deck navigation and starter workspaces.
